name: Grouped-Query Attention · GQA
tagline: Four query heads share each of three key/value heads.
description: Full causal attention with 12 query heads grouped four to a key/value head: three key/value heads of dimension 128. It is the native attention with three key/value heads and the same shared-key normalization as MQA, trained from scratch at 26 layers and FFN 6144.
paperTitle: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
mechanism: 12 query heads in 3 groups of 4; 3 key/value heads, dimension 128
RoPE and QK RMSNorm × 1.2 on each key head, broadcast within its group
Full causal attention in all 26 layers; no value embeddings
limitations: Three key/value heads is this project's registered choice. Trained from scratch, without uptraining from a multi-head checkpoint. Value embeddings are disabled in this family because their width follows the key/value heads; the matching multi-head control without them has not been trained. No KV-cache or decoding saving is measured. Single seed 42; trained from the frozen Others branch, not yet ported to the current code.
